facts.fact: The FY2026/27 estimates appropriate P213,700,000 (BWP) for the Research and Development project (12482) of the Ministry of Communications and Innovation, financed from the domestic development fund.
facts.system: Ministry of Communications and Innovation Research and Development project 12482, FY2026/27

facts.fact: The project's FY2026/27 appropriation of P213,700,000 is 55.2% below the FY2025/26 appropriation of P477,403,718.
facts.system: Ministry of Communications and Innovation Research and Development project 12482, FY2026/27 vs FY2025/26
